messages:
elaine (Docs): Quick heads-up — I opened a draft for the next release notes PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pulls/452. Main callouts: adaptive routing telemetry section, a known-canary latency bullet, Python SDK streaming snippet needs an update, and localization prep for the new telemetry copy. Can we triage?

mike (PM): Thanks Elaine. Priorities: 1) concise telemetry blurb, 2) known issue for canary vs dedicated latency with repro steps, 3) SDK snippet update + compatibility note, 4) L10N keys.

toni (Eng): I can write the repro steps for the canary latency. Quick note — the fallback routing change causes head-of-line latency spikes under synthetic QPS. I'll paste a short repro in a sec.

elaine (Docs): Awesome. Repro, and a one-sentence troubleshooting step (how to force dedicated) would be perfect. Also need a tiny copy for the changelog: one sentence + a link to the full mitigation doc.

sam (DevEx): On the SDK snippet — the streaming API changed in 2.1.0. Current snippet in docs uses `stream=True` which is deprecated. Suggested replacement (minimal):
```python
resp = client.chat.stream(model='kestrel-v1', input=prompt)
for chunk in resp:
    sys.stdout.write(chunk.delta)
```
We should also call out: "Requires SDK >= 2.1.0" and provide fallback example for older SDKs.

yvonne (L10N): L10N needs all new user-facing strings extracted into i18n keys. Can you list the exact strings to translate and the path (repo) where they live? We need the keys by EOD to sequence translations. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

elaine (Docs): Strings: 
- "Adaptive routing telemetry enabled — see details"
- "Known issue: canary latency under heavy burst"
- SDK compatibility note: "Requires SDK >= 2.1.0"
Path: docs/content/release-notes/0.9.x/*.md and docs/src/snippets/python/streaming.md
Please add to the l10n tracker: https://l10n.internal/tasks/1782

mike (PM): Legal wants a short privacy-safe telemetry blurb. legal-bot: any blockers?

legal-bot: Please avoid implying per-user profiling. Recommended copy: "We collect aggregated telemetry (latency, error rates) to improve routing decisions. No user text payloads are stored as part of this telemetry."

elaine (Docs): Perfect — I'll incorporate that as a footnote under telemetry.

toni (Eng): Repro steps for canary latency:
1) Deploy canary with 10% traffic.
2) Run 200 QPS, 95th pct tokens ~512, sustained for 2m.
3) Observe 95th latency on canary climb ~40% vs dedicated due to cold KV cache and routing thrash.
Mitigation: pin to dedicated (route policy: region+duty) or warm prefixes. I'll link a runbook in the doc.

sam (DevEx): For the SDK fallback we can add this snippet for <=2.0.x users:
```python
# older SDK streaming
res = client.chat.create(..., stream=True)
for chunk in res:
    print(chunk)
```
And under a compatibility note: "If you cannot upgrade, use the legacy streaming API above — behavior may differ."

yvonne (L10N): Got the keys and paths, adding to the queue. ETA for translations: 48h once keys are in.

mike (PM): Docs owners — who will be the final signer for release notes? Elaine? 

elaine (Docs): I'll shepherd; need thumbs from Toni (tech accuracy), Sam (snippets), Yvonne (l10n readiness), and Legal.

deploy-bot: docs-ci: build succeeded for branch release-notes/0.9.3 (job #1428) :white_check_mark:

elaine (Docs): Great — I'll push a small copy update and ping reviewers. Can everyone react with :thumbsup: when you're done?

toni (Eng): :thumbsup:

sam (DevEx): :thumbsup: updated snippet ✅

yvonne (L10N): Added keys and scheduled translations ✅

elaine (Docs): Thanks — leaving the PR open for final legal text insertion. Plan to merge tomorrow AM after a last pass.
